title: "Outperforming Imperative with Pure Functional Languages" by Richard Feldman
summary: Richard Feldman explains how pure functional languages can match or beat imperative ones on performance. Compilers can turn immutable code into in-place mutation, avoiding naive copying. The talk draws on his work on the Roc language.
why: Recommended as the clearest explanation of why immutable data need not be slow, and as the introduction to Roc.

quote.text: As a starting point for those nitty grittys, this talk is probably as good as any
